newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Donaghys warns on H2 earnings, sees bounce.
newsitem.headline: Donaghys warns on H2 earnings, sees bounce.

text.p: Diversified manufacturer Donaghys Limited said on Friday its second half profit and sales decline, foreshadowed earlier this year, had been greater than forecast.
However, it added in a statement that significant savings from the consolidation of several factories had led it to anticipate improved profitability in the first half of the 1997/98 financial year.
Significant savings from the consolidation of the Glendene and Feltex manufacturing operation into the other Donaghys factories would help that profitability.

Donaghys said its specialist machinery manufacturing unit Scott Technology, which will list shortly, had secured an engineering contract worth NZ$8.5 million to design and build a series of production lines for a major appliance company in Brazil.
Scott sales and profitability were in line with projections.
Donaghys said Arthur Ellis traded well in the year to June 30, and sales and profitability were also in line with forecasts.
